name: Maine Woodworks
old_description: We build custom-made furniture in Maine—thoughtful, well-made pieces designed to fit your home and your life.
about:
Maine Woodworks operates from Saco, Maine, where it was founded in 1991. The company builds custom-made furniture, emphasizing thoughtful design and craftsmanship tailored to individual homes.

The workshop produces made-to-order pieces across bedroom, dining, entryway, farmhouse, occasional, and office categories. Each item is handcrafted from regionally sourced sustainable hardwood using traditional English dovetail joinery, with customizable panel styles, leg and knob options, and eco-friendly finishes. Production lead times run six to eight weeks, and a white-glove delivery service includes assembly when required.

While primarily serving residential customers, Maine Woodworks also runs a Trade+Hospitality program for commercial and design-trade clients. The company sells directly through its Shopify-powered website and offers a gallery of configurable styles.

The brand positions itself on elevated design and heirloom-quality construction, highlighting that every piece is built one at a time in Maine to last for generations. Sustainable sourcing and full customization are cited as core differentiators.
